name: sponsor-engine
description: Open-source front desk and sponsor CRM for London communities and venues.

scripts.test: npm run build -w @sponsor-engine/pricing && npm test -w @sponsor-engine/pricing && npm test -w @sponsor-engine/recap && node --import tsx --test packages/db/test/*.test.ts packages/core/test/*.test.ts apps/site/test/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sponsor-engine/pricing && tsc -p packages/db --noEmit && tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/mcp --noEmit
